imagePullSecrets.$comment: Removed (issue 1024). Kept in the schema so that setting it reaches the clear render-time failure in koinon.pullSecretNames.

trustedProxies.description: CIDRs or addresses of the proxies in front of koinon-api whose X-Forwarded-For / Forwarded the limiters believe; empty trusts none

otlpPort.description: the internal OTLP/HTTP receiver for agentgateway's access log and agentd's run spans

guardPort.description: the MCP leak guard (ExtMcp gRPC), reachable only from agentgateway (ADR 0091)

leakGuardByteCap.description: bytes of external-low payload a run may send once its session holds both legs before the guard records one over-threshold event for the run; no call is refused for it (ADR 0091)

driver.description: Empty: koinon with execution.driver=substrate, agentgateway otherwise.

reconcilerFence.description: The admission policy that limits the reconciler's Secret writes to Secrets it owns (issue #604); separate from kek.guard.

kek.description: Key-encryption keys for stored provider keys and connection secrets (ADR 0056).

guard.description: Admission policy that guards the KEK Secret (issue #604).

kms.description: Wrapping the KEKs with a KMS (ADR 0085 decision 12); local by default.

readOnly.description: The read-only second wrapping key of a key move: the KMS key of before; it only unwraps (issue 688).

addKey.description: A KEK ID to add; "active" is the keyring's pointer, not an ID.

activateIfNoActive.description: With addKey: make the added KEK active when the KEK Secret has no usable active KEK (recovery from a lost KMS key that wrapped it).

rewrapUnbound.description: Bind the KEKs wrapped before old issue 615 to the install ID; a binary older than old issue 615 cannot read them then.

harnesses.description: Harness images (ADR 0035, ADR 0112). Agents of a harness without an image are reported as reconcile errors.

harnessPrepull.description: Pre-pull the harness images on the Kata nodes (plan item LT1).

sandboxNetworkPolicy.description: Default-deny NetworkPolicy for OpenShell sandbox namespaces (spike 8.15). On by default; standard networking.k8s.io/v1 only.

sandboxLimitRange.description: LimitRange for OpenShell sandbox namespaces (#76). On by default; sizes supervisor and init containers.

runtimeClasses.description: RuntimeClass names the sandbox policy admits for workload pods (ADR 0075). Any other class is refused by the policy itself.

supervisorTokenMaxSeconds.description: Longest expirationSeconds the policy admits for the projected openshell-gateway ServiceAccount token on supervisor pods (ADR 0006).
